items.criterion: One invoice exists in the billing platform for a completed pack purchase.
items.judgment: Read the invoice list and match the pack price in minor units.

items.criterion: A member holds exactly one billing account, found by external key.
items.judgment: Read the billing account list and count the rows carrying the key.

items.criterion: A balance equals the sum of the stored ledger entries behind it.
items.judgment: Sum the entries for the account and compare with the reported balance.

items.criterion: The entries of one transaction sum to zero.
items.judgment: Read the entries for the transaction and add the signed amounts.

items.criterion: One idempotency key yields one transaction however many times the call arrives.
items.judgment: Count the transactions carrying the key after repeated calls.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous purchases against a balance covering one leave one succeeding.
items.judgment: Fire two purchases from one barrier and count the successes.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous joins against one free slot issue one reservation.
items.judgment: Fire two joins from one barrier and count the reservations.

items.criterion: The platform share of a sale is truncated and the remainder reaches the creator.
items.judgment: Buy the three-Kredz item and read the two shares back.

items.criterion: A receipt reaches the buyer with the pinned subject prefix.
items.judgment: Poll the inbox for the prefix addressed to the buyer.

items.criterion: A member below an item's minimum band is refused the purchase.
items.judgment: Buy the teen-only item as the child account and read the refusal.

items.criterion: A player calling a creator route is refused by the server.
items.judgment: Read the creator sales route with a player session.

items.criterion: An age-ineligible experience reaches no viewer in the child band.
items.judgment: Search as the child account and scan the response.

items.criterion: A renamed published asset returns to moderation.
items.judgment: Rename a published asset and read the state back.

items.criterion: A fresh preview answers a state rather than an address.
items.judgment: Request the preview for a newly published asset.

items.criterion: The marketplace catalogue lists every seeded item.
items.judgment: Read the catalogue and compare the slugs.

items.criterion: A paged chart shows no row twice across two consecutive pages.
items.judgment: Page the chart by cursor and compare the two pages.
